cards.titleZh: 从阿杜利斯港到内陆象牙市场
cards.titleEn: From Adulis to the inland ivory markets
authors: W. H. Schoff (1912 translator and editor)

locator.htmlSection: Section 4 — Adulis and the inland ivory route
locator.section: 第4节 / Section 4; raw HTML lines 212–227

cards.summaryZh: 航行记把海湾中的停泊点、阿杜利斯聚落、科洛埃象牙市场和阿克苏姆人的城市连成一条贸易路线。作者还解释船只为何改换锚地。顺着货物流动阅读，能看到港口安全与内陆集散怎样相互联系。
cards.summaryEn: The account connects offshore anchorages, the settlement of Adulis, the ivory market at Coloe, and the city of the Auxumites. It also explains why ships changed their anchorage. Following this movement of goods reveals how port security and inland collection were linked.
cards.scopeZh: 第4节；与Axum I的市场设施IP、港口P两条原记录对读。原文以行程天数描述内陆联系。
cards.scopeEn: Section 4, alongside Axum I rows for markets IP and ports P. The account expresses inland connections in days of travel.
cards.sourceSnapshot: Schoff 1912 translation; Fordham page © Paul Halsall October 2000; retrieved 2026-10-10

cards.titleZh: 货单里的交换方式：铜块、钱币与跨海贸易
cards.titleEn: Brass, coins, and exchange across the sea
authors: W. H. Schoff (1912 translator and editor)

locator.htmlSection: Section 6 — Imports, exports, and means of exchange
locator.section: 第6节 / Section 6; raw HTML lines 235–251

cards.summaryZh: 第6节列出埃及织物、铜铁器材、印度铁钢与棉布等进口品，出口则包括象牙、龟甲和犀角。货单中还出现切成小块、用来替代钱币的黄铜，以及少量钱币，帮助我们比较商品用途和支付方式。
cards.summaryEn: Section 6 lists Egyptian textiles, copper and iron supplies, Indian iron and steel, and cotton cloth among imports; exports include ivory, tortoiseshell, and rhinoceros horn. Brass cut into pieces for exchange appears beside a little coin, inviting comparison between goods and means of payment.
cards.scopeZh: 第6节；关联兼作货币的实用品P、外来钱币P。钱币铸造地与交易规模在这一段未注明。
cards.scopeEn: Section 6, linked to articles used as money P and foreign coins P. The passage supplies neither a mint attribution nor transaction totals.
cards.sourceSnapshot: Schoff 1912 translation; Fordham page © Paul Halsall October 2000; retrieved 2026-10-10

cards.titleZh: 一部法律如何形成：议事、签署与记录
cards.titleEn: Making a law: deliberation, signatures, and records
authors: University of Nebraska–Lincoln, U.S. Law and Race Initiative OER (digital transcription)

locator.htmlSection: Respecting the Representative Body; Respecting the Meetings of the Legislative Body
locator.section: 代表机构与立法会议 / Representative body and legislative meetings; printed pp. 13–14

cards.summaryZh: 1840年宪法规定代表由各岛人民选出，贵族与代表各自议事，也可合议。新法须获双方多数同意，再由国王与总理签署；两方各设书记，将决议记录成册并保存。沿着这套程序，可以读懂立法权与文字记录的关系。
cards.summaryEn: The 1840 constitution provides for representatives chosen by the people of the islands. Nobles and representatives deliberate separately or jointly; a new law requires both majorities and the signatures of the king and premier. Each body keeps a secretary and a preserved decision book, connecting lawmaking to written records.
cards.scopeZh: 代表机构及立法会议条款；正式法律体系、文字记录原值均为P。档案馆扫描第5—6页（印刷页13—14）。
cards.scopeEn: Representative-body and legislative-meeting clauses; formal legal code and written records both have raw value P. Archive scan pages 5–6 (printed pp. 13–14).
cards.sourceSnapshot: Constitution signed 1840-10-08; UNL transcription cites Lahainaluna 1842 translation; item modified 2026-08-05; retrieved 2026-10-10

cards.titleEn: How taxes moved through the administration
authors: University of Nebraska–Lincoln, U.S. Law and Race Initiative OER (digital transcription)

locator.section: 税官条款 / Tax officers; archive scan pp. 6–7 (printed pp. 14–15)

cards.summaryZh: 宪法让国王与总理任命税官，由税官核定税额并预先告知人民，征收后依次交给总督、总理与国王。税官还管理公共劳役，并处理部分土地纠纷。把这几项职责一起读，能看见财政、行政与裁断在同一职务中的交汇。
cards.summaryEn: The constitution assigns appointment of tax officers to the king and premier. Officers assess and announce taxes, then pass collections through the governor and premier to the king. They also oversee public labor and hear some land disputes, bringing finance, administration, and adjudication together in one office.
cards.scopeZh: 税官条款；行政层级原值4—4。专职行政人员两行保留1820—1840年SA与1840—1898年P，1840年为原表交叠端点。
cards.scopeEn: Tax-officer clauses; administrative levels have raw range 4–4. Full-time bureaucracy retains both rows: SA for 1820–1840 and P for 1840–1898, including their shared endpoint.
cards.sourceSnapshot: Constitution signed 1840-10-08; UNL transcription cites Lahainaluna 1842 translation; item modified 2026-08-05; retrieved 2026-10-10

cards.titleZh: 从地方审理到最高法院
cards.titleEn: From local hearings to the Supreme Court
authors: University of Nebraska–Lincoln, U.S. Law and Race Initiative OER (digital transcription)

locator.htmlSection: Of the Judges; Of the Supreme Judges
locator.section: 法官与最高法官 / Judges and supreme judges; printed p. 15

cards.summaryZh: 各岛总督任命法官，开庭日期须预先公布。宪法把税务及部分土地纠纷另交税官处理，同时为不服裁判者设置复审途径。最高法院由国王、总理和代表机构选任的四人组成，可把这些条款与相邻税官职责连读。
cards.summaryEn: Island governors appoint judges, and court dates must be announced in advance. Tax and certain land disputes go to tax officers, with routes for further hearing. The Supreme Court combines the king, premier, and four people appointed by the representative body; read these clauses beside the tax officers’ jurisdiction.
cards.scopeZh: 法官、最高法官及税官末段；关联专职法官P、专用审判建筑P。这里可比较司法职权与复审程序；专职任职和专用建筑另需材料核实。档案馆扫描第6—7页（印刷页14—15）。
cards.scopeEn: Judges, supreme judges, and the closing tax-officer paragraph, alongside full-time judges P and dedicated court buildings P. Compare judicial responsibilities and review procedures here; full-time service and dedicated buildings require separate evidence. Archive scan pages 6–7 (printed pp. 14–15).
cards.sourceSnapshot: Constitution signed 1840-10-08; UNL transcription cites Lahainaluna 1842 translation; item modified 2026-08-05; retrieved 2026-10-10
